areas.name: Matrix analysis toolkit
areas.summary: Deterministic facts every RandNLA proof reaches for: SVD, best low-rank approximation, perturbation, projections, pseudoinverse, trace inequalities, the Loewner order.

areas.name: Trace inequalities and the Loewner order
Gaussian and random matrix facts
areas.summary: What a standard Gaussian matrix does: invariance, moments, inverse moments of the pseudoinverse, extreme singular values. The bottleneck for every Gaussian-sketch argument.

areas.name: Concentration inequalities
areas.summary: Scalar and matrix tail bounds. The matrix side is done (Tropp Ch. 3–8); the scalar side is scattered across Mathlib and external libraries.

areas.name: Sketching primitives
areas.summary: Johnson–Lindenstrauss, subspace embeddings, approximate matrix multiplication, leverage-score sampling. The vocabulary in which randomized algorithms are analysed.

areas.name: Low-rank approximation
areas.summary: Deterministic structural lemmas (projection error, truncation, power iteration, Nyström) and the randomized algorithm guarantees that consume them.

areas.name: Trace, diagonal and quadratic-form estimation
areas.summary: Hutchinson-type estimators, their variance and tails, spectral measures. Small statements with very high reuse.

areas.name: Krylov and polynomial methods
areas.summary: Krylov subspaces, Lanczos, Gauss quadrature, Chebyshev bounds. Deterministic, but the backbone of the modern randomized low-rank and trace-estimation algorithms.

areas.name: Randomized solvers (consumers)
areas.summary: Sketch-and-solve, sketch-and-precondition, Kaczmarz and sketch-and-project. Mostly consumers of sketching and matrix facts; Kaczmarz is itself a clean foundation.

results.title: Frobenius and spectral norms: mixed inequalities
results.informal: ‖AB‖_F ≤ ‖A‖‖B‖_F, ‖AB‖_F ≤ ‖A‖_F‖B‖, ‖A‖ ≤ ‖A‖_F ≤ √rank(A)·‖A‖, unitary invariance of both norms, ‖A‖_F² = tr(AᵀA) = Σσ_i².

formalizations.note: consolidated API in NLAlib/Matrix/Norms.lean: frobInner algebra, Pythagoras, Cauchy–Schwarz, triangle inequality, unitary invariance, mixed Frobenius/spectral inequalities, Frobenius submultiplicativity, specNorm ≤ frobNorm
definition bundle GaussianMatrix_basic defines frobNorm and specNorm

mathlib_prereqs.note: scoped instance for the ℓ₂ operator norm

results.notes: Done. Mathlib lacks ‖A‖₂ ≤ ‖A‖_F for the L2 operator norm and a transpose version of l2_opNorm_conjTranspose; both proved here and are upstream candidates.

results.title: Singular value decomposition of a matrix
results.informal: Every A ∈ ℝ^{m×n} factors as A = UΣVᵀ with U, V orthogonal and Σ diagonal with σ₁ ≥ … ≥ σ_min(m,n) ≥ 0. Block form A = U₁Σ₁V₁ᵀ + U₂Σ₂V₂ᵀ split at rank k.

formalizations.note: IsSVD A U V: Uᵀ U = 1, Vᵀ V = 1, A = U · rectDiag (singularValues A) · Vᵀ, where singularValues A : ℕ → ℝ is Mathlib's LinearMap.singularValues of toEuclideanLin A (zero-indexed, antitone, zero beyond the rank). Also uniqueness of σ, block split at k (IsSVD.eq_head_add_tail), AᵀA and AAᵀ diagonalisations, frobSq = Σσ², invariance under orthogonal factors and transpose.

mathlib_prereqs.note: used as the definition of the singular values
the sorted eigenvalues; note Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues is NOT sorted

results.notes: Done. Next lemma wanted: singularValues A 0 = specNorm A, which Weyl and Eckart–Young need.

results.title: Eckart–Young–Mirsky: best rank-k approximation
results.informal: min_{rank B ≤ k} ‖A − B‖ = σ_{k+1}(A) and min ‖A − B‖_F² = Σ_{i>k} σ_i², both attained by the truncated SVD ⟦A⟧_k.
results.notes: OPT in every low-rank bound. The LRA project currently takes 'IsBestRankApprox' as a hypothesis (rank_mul_le_of_isBestRankApprox).

results.title: Weyl and Mirsky perturbation bounds for singular values
results.informal: |σ_i(A+E) − σ_i(A)| ≤ ‖E‖ for every i, and (Σ_i (σ_i(A+E) − σ_i(A))²)^{1/2} ≤ ‖E‖_F.

results.title: Courant–Fischer min-max and Rayleigh quotients
results.informal: λ_k(A) = max_{dim S = k} min_{x ∈ S, ‖x‖=1} xᵀAx for Hermitian A; λ_max = sup of the Rayleigh quotient, λ_min = inf.

mathlib_prereqs.note: sup/inf of the Rayleigh quotient equals the extreme eigenvalue

results.notes: The user's definitions lambdaMax/lambdaMin (Tropp) and lamMin (LRA) are both the Rayleigh form; the full min-max is what interlacing and Weyl need.

results.title: Cauchy interlacing for principal submatrices and compressions
results.informal: If Q has k orthonormal columns then λ_{i+n−k}(A) ≤ λ_i(QᵀAQ) ≤ λ_i(A). Used for Nyström, Lanczos/Ritz values and column subset selection.

results.title: Rank: products, sums, and rank-k matrices
results.informal: rank(AB) ≤ min(rank A, rank B); rank(A+B) ≤ rank A + rank B; rank(QX) = rank X for Q with orthonormal columns.

results.title: Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse and its identities
results.informal: A† defined via the SVD; the four Penrose identities; A† = (AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀ for full column rank, Aᵀ(AAᵀ)⁻¹ for full row rank; AA† is the orthogonal projector onto range(A); ‖A†‖ = 1/σ_min; ‖G†‖_F² = tr((GGᵀ)⁻¹).

formalizations.note: full-rank pseudoinverses pinvL/pinvR with the Penrose identities, projector properties and ‖G†‖_F² = tr (GGᵀ)⁻¹. The general Moore–Penrose definition (rank-deficient case) is still open; tracked as the remaining gap of this entry.
pinv for full-row-rank G only
full-rank special cases only

mathlib_prereqs.note: Mathlib's ⁻¹ is total (0 on singular input)

results.notes: Full-rank case complete. Remaining gap: a general Moore–Penrose definition via the SVD with the four Penrose identities for rank-deficient G.

results.title: Orthogonal projectors and residuals
results.informal: For Q with orthonormal columns: P = QQᵀ is an orthogonal projector; ‖A‖_F² = ‖PA‖_F² + ‖(I−P)A‖_F²; range(AΩ) ⊆ range(Q) ⇒ (I−P)AΩ = 0; monotonicity of projection error under range inclusion.

formalizations.note: projector identities, residual algebra, Pythagoras, contraction, range-inclusion monotonicity (HMT Prop 8.5, Frobenius), best-in-range lemma

mathlib_prereqs.note: abstract version in inner product spaces

results.notes: Done. Includes the monotonicity result with Q₁ arbitrary (stronger than HMT Prop 8.5 as asked).

results.title: Completing an orthonormal frame to an orthogonal matrix
results.informal: If Q ∈ ℝ^{m×q} has orthonormal columns there is Q⊥ ∈ ℝ^{m×(m−q)} with [Q Q⊥] orthogonal: QQᵀ + Q⊥Q⊥ᵀ = I and QᵀQ⊥ = 0.

formalizations.note: matrix form: V with orthonormal columns along an embedding ι ↪ Fin n extends to an orthogonal W; lives in Gaussian/Invariance.lean, to move to Matrix/Projections
abstract form, used directly inside exists_isSVD

mathlib_prereqs.note: abstract version exists; needs a matrix-level statement

results.notes: Mathlib's abstract completion suffices; the matrix wrapper exists_orthogonal_completion lives in Gaussian/Invariance.lean and should move to Matrix/Projections.

results.title: Von Neumann trace inequality and its rank-r corollary
results.informal: ⟨X, E⟩_F ≤ Σ_i σ_i(X)σ_i(E). Corollary: if rank X ≤ r then ⟨X,E⟩_F ≤ ‖X‖_*‖E‖ ≤ √r‖X‖_F‖E‖.
results.notes: Consumed by tGN_expected_error as the hypothesis hVN.

results.title: Loewner order and the continuous functional calculus on matrices
results.informal: A ≼ B iff B − A is PSD; monotonicity of trace and of conjugation; f(A) for Hermitian A via eigen-decomposition; sqrt, exp, log.

formalizations.note: scoped MatrixOrder

results.title: Operator monotone/concave log, operator Jensen, Lieb concavity
results.informal: log is operator monotone and operator concave; the operator Jensen inequality; A ↦ tr exp(H + log A) is concave on PD matrices (Lieb).

results.title: Golden–Thompson inequality
results.informal: tr exp(A + B) ≤ tr(exp(A) exp(B)) for Hermitian A, B. Not needed by Tropp's route (which uses Lieb) but cited constantly.

formalizations.note: README mentions a finite-dimensional route to Golden–Thompson; not verified here

results.title: Schur complements and block PSD criteria
results.informal: [[A,B],[Bᵀ,C]] ≽ 0 iff A ≽ 0 and C − BᵀA†B ≽ 0 (A invertible case); used for Nyström and dilations.

results.title: Hermitian dilation of a rectangular matrix
results.informal: 𝓗(B) = [[0,B],[Bᵀ,0]] is Hermitian with ‖𝓗(B)‖ = ‖B‖ and 𝓗(B)² = diag(BBᵀ, BᵀB).

results.title: Standard Gaussian matrix: law and basic properties
results.informal: G ∈ ℝ^{m×n} with i.i.d. N(0,1) entries as the product measure; Frobenius/spectral norms, σ_min, pseudoinverse on this space.

formalizations.note: standard Gaussian on a finite-dimensional inner product space

results.title: Rotation invariance of the Gaussian matrix
results.informal: UGV has the same law as G for fixed orthogonal U, V.

formalizations.note: ported from the Prove2me solution; proof goes through Mathlib's stdGaussian_map

mathlib_prereqs.note: image of stdGaussian under a linear isometry equivalence

results.title: Blocks V₁ᵀΩ, V₂ᵀΩ are Gaussian and independent
results.informal: For [V₁ V₂] with orthonormal columns and V₁ᵀV₂ = 0, V₁ᵀΩ is standard Gaussian and independent of V₂ᵀΩ. The engine behind every conditioning step.

results.title: E‖SΓT‖_F² = ‖S‖_F²‖T‖_F²
results.informal: Second Frobenius moment of a Gaussian matrix sandwiched between fixed matrices.

formalizations.note: more general than HMT Prop 10.1: arbitrary finite outer index types

results.title: Fourth Frobenius moment of SΓT
results.informal: E‖SΓT‖_F⁴ = (‖S‖_F²‖T‖_F²)² + 2‖SᵀS‖_F²‖TTᵀ‖_F².

results.title: Isserlis / Wick formula for Gaussian moments
results.informal: E[g_{i1}⋯g_{i2k}] = Σ over pairings of products of covariances. General engine for all polynomial moments (fourth moments, Hutchinson variance, AMM).
results.notes: Special cases (fourth moments) are proved by hand; the general formula would remove the case-by-case work.

results.title: Gaussian approximate matrix multiplication identity
results.informal: For S = t^{-1/2}Ω: E‖MSSᵀNᵀ − MNᵀ‖_F² = (‖M‖_F²‖N‖_F² + ‖MNᵀ‖_F²)/t.

results.title: A Gaussian matrix has full rank almost surely
results.informal: For k ≤ t, {det(GGᵀ) = 0} is Lebesgue-null. Discharges every 'IsUnit' side condition in the LRA theorems.

formalizations.note: via: a nonzero multivariate polynomial in the entries is a.s. nonzero (not in Mathlib)

results.title: Chi-square lower tail
results.informal: P[χ²_d ≤ u] ≤ (e u / d)^{d/2} for u ≤ d.

results.title: Chi-square upper tail (Laurent–Massart / Dasgupta–Gupta)
results.informal: P[χ²_d ≥ (1+ε)d] ≤ exp(−(d/2)(ε − log(1+ε))) and P[χ²_d ≥ d + 2√(dx) + 2x] ≤ e^{−x}.

mathlib_prereqs.note: the sub-exponential case is not in Mathlib

results.notes: The missing half of the JL ingredient; the lower tail is already proved.

formalizations.note: over any finite index type with card ≥ 3

results.title: Mean of the inverse Wishart matrix
results.informal: E(GGᵀ)⁻¹ = I_r/(k − r − 1) for G ∈ ℝ^{r×k}, k ≥ r + 2.

formalizations.note: entrywise integrability and mean (1/(k−r−1))·I; proof via Schur complement of the other rows and the residual law
SKETCH_ACCEPTED with all children ACCEPTED (schur_diag_inv, residual_law)

results.title: E‖G†‖_F² = r/(k−r−1)
results.informal: Second Frobenius moment of the pseudoinverse of an r×k Gaussian matrix.

formalizations.note: ∫ frobSq (pinvR G) = r/(k−r−1) under gaussianMatrix r k, r+2 ≤ k

results.title: Fourth Frobenius moment of G†
results.informal: E‖G†‖_F⁴ in closed form (second identity of Tropp–Webber Lemma B.2).

results.title: E‖(GGᵀ)⁻¹‖_F²
results.informal: Closed form r(k−1)/((k−r)(k−r−1)(k−r−3)).

results.title: E‖G†‖ ≤ e√k/(k−r)
results.informal: Expected spectral norm of the pseudoinverse.

formalizations.note: SKETCH_ACCEPTED; open child pinv_spectral_tail

results.title: Spectral moments of (GGᵀ)⁻¹
results.informal: (E‖(GGᵀ)⁻¹‖^p)^{1/p} ≤ e²(k+r)/(2(k−r)²) for 1 ≤ p ≤ 18. Mission II goal.

results.title: Gaussian Lipschitz concentration
results.informal: For L-Lipschitz h: P[h(G) ≥ E h + Lt] ≤ e^{−t²/2}. The single most reused Gaussian fact; needed by Gordon, Chevet, σ_min tails and the spectral moment bounds.

formalizations.note: proved there via Gaussian log-Sobolev; not on Mathlib's Gaussian API, would need transport

results.notes: Blocks three open Mission III items and Mission II's goal. Candidate proofs: Pisier's smart-path interpolation (shortest), or Gaussian log-Sobolev + Herbst.

results.title: σ_min and ‖·‖ are 1-Lipschitz in the Frobenius norm
results.informal: |σ_min(A) − σ_min(B)| ≤ ‖A − B‖ ≤ ‖A − B‖_F, same for the spectral norm.

results.title: Gordon's theorem: expected extreme singular values
results.informal: √N − √n ≤ E σ_min(G) ≤ E σ_max(G) ≤ √N + √n for G ∈ ℝ^{N×n}.
results.notes: Needs the Gaussian comparison (Slepian/Gordon) inequality or the Davidson–Szarek route; hardest open item in the Gaussian series.

results.title: Chevet-type bound: E‖SΓT‖ ≤ ‖S‖‖T‖_F + ‖S‖_F‖T‖
results.informal: Expected spectral norm of a sandwiched Gaussian matrix.

results.title: (E‖SΓT‖²)^{1/2} ≤ ‖S‖‖T‖_F + ‖S‖_F‖T‖
results.informal: Second-moment form of Chevet; consumed by tGN as GaussianSpectralMoment.

results.title: Lower tail of σ_min (Davidson–Szarek)
results.informal: P[σ_min(G) ≤ √N − √n − u] ≤ e^{−u²/2}.

formalizations.note: SKETCH_ACCEPTED; open children gordon, gaussian_concentration

results.title: Small-ball bound for σ_min
results.informal: P[σ_min(G) ≤ s] ≤ n(e n s²/(N−n+1))^{(N−n+1)/2} for N×n Gaussian G.

results.title: Two-sided deviation of extreme singular values
results.informal: √N − √n − t ≤ σ_min(G) ≤ σ_max(G) ≤ √N + √n + t with probability ≥ 1 − 2e^{−t²/2}. Mission III goal; the Gaussian subspace embedding in one line.

formalizations.note: SKETCH_ACCEPTED; open children gordon, gaussian_concentration

results.title: Haar-distributed orthogonal matrices from Gaussian QR
results.informal: The Q factor of a Gaussian matrix is Haar on the Stiefel manifold; random orthonormal test matrices.

results.title: Sub-Gaussian random variables (MGF form)
results.informal: X has sub-Gaussian MGF with parameter c: E e^{tX} ≤ e^{ct²/2}.

results.title: Rademacher vectors and the scalar Khintchine inequality
results.informal: Rademacher ±1 variables are sub-Gaussian with c = 1; E|Σ a_i ε_i|^p ≤ C_p^p ‖a‖^p. Needed for Rademacher sketches and Hutchinson variance.

formalizations.note: law only

results.title: Operator norm via ε-nets and covering numbers of the sphere
results.informal: |𝒩(S^{n−1}, ε)| ≤ (1 + 2/ε)^n, and ‖A‖ ≤ (1−2ε)^{-1} max_{x∈𝒩} ‖Ax‖. The deterministic half of every sub-Gaussian random matrix bound.

formalizations.note: volumetric covering bound only

results.title: Norm of a matrix with independent sub-Gaussian rows
results.informal: √N − C√n − t ≤ σ_min(A) ≤ σ_max(A) ≤ √N + C√n + t w.p. ≥ 1 − 2e^{−ct²} for A ∈ ℝ^{N×n} with isotropic sub-Gaussian rows. Gives subspace embeddings for Rademacher and other dense sketches.

results.title: Markov and Chebyshev inequalities
results.informal: P[X ≥ t] ≤ E X / t; P[|X − EX| ≥ t] ≤ Var X / t².

results.title: Chernoff bound for sums of independent sub-Gaussian variables
results.informal: P[Σ X_i ≥ t] ≤ exp(−t²/(2Σc_i)) for independent X_i with sub-Gaussian MGFs.

results.title: Hoeffding's lemma and inequality
results.informal: Bounded X ∈ [a,b] is sub-Gaussian with c = (b−a)²/4; tail for bounded independent sums.

formalizations.note: Hoeffding's lemma in MGF form

results.title: Bernstein inequality (sub-exponential sums)
results.informal: Tail for sums of centered sub-exponential variables, with the variance/range crossover.

results.title: Hanson–Wright inequality
results.informal: P[|xᵀAx − E xᵀAx| ≥ t] ≤ 2 exp(−c min(t²/(K⁴‖A‖_F²), t/(K²‖A‖))) for x with independent sub-Gaussian coordinates. The tail bound behind trace estimation and JL for sub-Gaussian sketches.

formalizations.note: constant hansonWrightUniversalConstant = 1/(4·64·e²); hypotheses iIndepFun X μ and ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) K² μ; conclusion on |centeredQuadraticForm| with its own Frobenius/operator norm definitions. Port, do not depend (Lean v4.29.1 pin).

results.notes: HighDimProb has a complete proof in Mathlib's vocabulary. Porting it to the v4.33.1 pin plus transport lemmas to Matrix.frobeniusNorm and the L2 operator norm is the cheapest route to a Proved Hanson–Wright on Prove2me.

results.title: McDiarmid's bounded-differences inequality
results.informal: Concentration of functions with bounded coordinate-wise differences. Used for sampling-based sketches.

results.title: Matrix Laplace transform method and master bounds
results.informal: E λ_max(Y) ≤ inf_θ θ^{-1} log tr exp(Σ log E e^{θX_k}) and the matching tail, for independent Hermitian summands.

results.title: Matrix Gaussian and Rademacher series
results.informal: E‖Σ γ_k A_k‖ ≤ √(2σ² log(d₁+d₂)) with σ² = max(‖ΣA_kA_kᵀ‖, ‖ΣA_kᵀA_k‖).

results.title: Matrix Chernoff inequality
results.informal: Upper and lower tails for λ_max, λ_min of a sum of independent PSD matrices bounded by L.

results.title: Matrix Bernstein inequality
results.informal: Tail and expectation bounds for ‖ΣS_k‖ with ‖S_k‖ ≤ L and matrix variance v.

results.title: Intrinsic-dimension Chernoff and Bernstein
results.informal: Replaces log d with log intdim(V).

results.title: Sampling lemma: sums of independent rank-one PSD samples
results.informal: If x_j are i.i.d. with E x_jxᵀ_j = I and ‖x_j‖² ≤ L a.s., then (1/k)Σ x_jx_jᵀ has eigenvalues in [1−ε, 1+ε] with probability ≥ 1 − 2d·exp(−kε²/(cL)). The one corollary of matrix Chernoff that every sampling-based embedding uses.
results.notes: Matrix Chernoff is proved; this packaging is cheap and unlocks SRHT, leverage-score sampling and sparsification.

results.title: Matrix Freedman / martingale Bernstein
results.informal: Martingale version of matrix Bernstein; used for adaptive sampling and streaming.

results.title: Non-commutative Khintchine inequality
results.informal: Moment form of the matrix series bound; sharper for subspace embeddings.

results.title: Distributional JL for a Gaussian sketch
results.informal: For S = k^{-1/2}G: P[|‖Sx‖² − ‖x‖²| > ε‖x‖²] ≤ 2exp(−k(ε²/4 − ε³/6)).

formalizations.note: SCAFFOLD: statement in place, proof deferred until the chi-square tails exist

results.title: Johnson–Lindenstrauss lemma
results.informal: n points embed into k = O(ε^{-2} log n) dimensions with all pairwise distances preserved to 1 ± ε; union bound over the distributional lemma.

formalizations.note: union bound over ordered pairs (factor 2 vs N(N−1)/2); explicit constant 48 log N / ε² for failure probability ≤ 1/2; proved modulo the scaffold jl_distributional

results.notes: Proof complete on top of the distributional lemma; becomes proved automatically once jl_distributional is discharged.

results.title: Distributional JL for sub-Gaussian sketches
results.informal: Same conclusion for Rademacher and other sub-Gaussian entries, from Hanson–Wright.

results.title: Subspace embedding: definition and equivalent forms
results.informal: S is an ε-subspace embedding for range(U) (U orthonormal) iff ‖SUx‖² ∈ (1±ε)‖x‖² for all x iff σ(SU) ⊂ [√(1−ε), √(1+ε)] iff ‖UᵀSᵀSU − I‖ ≤ ε. Oblivious vs. data-dependent variants.

formalizations.note: definition, orthonormal-basis form, basis independence, monotonicity, and the Gram-form sufficient condition ‖(SU)ᵀSU − I‖ ≤ ε. Open: converse of the Gram form and the singular-value form (needs svd).

results.notes: The vocabulary of modern RandNLA; every sketch result is stated against it.

results.title: Gaussian matrices are oblivious subspace embeddings
results.informal: k^{-1/2}G with k ≥ C(d + log(1/δ))/ε² is an ε-subspace embedding for any fixed d-dimensional subspace with probability 1 − δ.
results.notes: One line from the Mission III goal plus rotation invariance.

results.title: Subsampled randomized Hadamard transform is a subspace embedding
results.informal: SRHT with k = O(ε^{-2}(d + log n) log d) rows is an ε-subspace embedding; proof = row flattening by random signs + matrix Chernoff sampling.

formalizations.note: a rerandomized variant with prescribed width k = O(r/ε²); not the classical statement

results.title: Sparse oblivious subspace embeddings (CountSketch, OSNAP, SparseStack)
results.informal: CountSketch with k = O(d²/ε²) rows is an OSE; OSNAP/SparseStack with O(d/ε²) rows and few nonzeros per column.

formalizations.note: SparseStack main theorem verified in Lean per the abstract

results.title: Approximate matrix multiplication by row sampling
results.informal: Sampling c column/row pairs with probabilities p_i ∝ ‖A_{:,i}‖‖B_{i,:}‖: E‖AB − CR‖_F² ≤ ‖A‖_F²‖B‖_F²/c.

results.title: Approximate multiplication from a subspace embedding
results.informal: If S satisfies the JL moment property then E‖AᵀSᵀSB − AᵀB‖_F² ≤ (ε²)‖A‖_F²‖B‖_F². The glue between embeddings and least squares.

results.title: Leverage scores: definition and basic properties
results.informal: ℓ_i(A) = ‖U_{i,:}‖² = (AA†)_{ii}; Σℓ_i = rank A; 0 ≤ ℓ_i ≤ 1; invariant under change of basis of range(A).

results.title: Leverage-score row sampling is a subspace embedding
results.informal: Sampling k = O(ε^{-2} d log(d/δ)) rows with p_i ∝ ℓ_i and rescaling gives an ε-subspace embedding w.p. 1 − δ. Same theorem gives spectral sparsification.

results.title: Volume sampling and column subset selection
results.informal: Sampling k columns with probability ∝ squared volume gives E‖A − π_S(A)‖_F² ≤ (k+1)‖A − ⟦A⟧_k‖_F².

results.title: Deterministic range-finder bound, Frobenius form
results.informal: If range(AΩ) ⊆ range(Q) and Ω₁ = V₁ᵀΩ has full row rank, ‖(I−QQᵀ)A‖_F² ≤ ‖Σ₂‖_F² + ‖Σ₂Ω₂Ω₁†‖_F².

formalizations.note: HMT Thm 9.1, Frobenius form, slightly more general than the source (no diagonal S, no U₁ hypotheses); plus the truncated variant (Chen–Persson prop:hmt-struct)

results.title: Deterministic range-finder bound, spectral form
results.informal: Same hypotheses: ‖(I−QQᵀ)A‖² ≤ ‖Σ₂‖² + ‖Σ₂Ω₂Ω₁†‖².
results.notes: The Frobenius form is proved; the spectral form needs ‖[X Y]‖² ≤ ‖X‖² + ‖Y‖² style block norm lemmas.

results.title: Truncating a projected matrix
results.informal: ‖A − Q⟦QᵀA⟧_k‖_F² ≤ ‖A − ⟦A⟧_k‖_F² + 2‖(I−QQᵀ)A‖_F²-type bounds, and the exact identity for the early-truncated variant.

results.title: Tail of the singular value sequence
results.informal: σ_{ℓ+1}² ≤ (1/(ℓ−k))Σ_{i>k}σ_i², i.e. σ_{⌈t/2⌉+1}² ≤ (4/t)·OPT² for t ≥ 4k.

results.title: Power-iteration error amplification
results.informal: For Y = (AAᵀ)^q AΩ and Q = orth(Y): ‖(I−QQᵀ)A‖ ≤ ‖(I−QQᵀ)(AAᵀ)^qA‖^{1/(2q+1)}. Turns the RSVD bound into a bound with σ_{k+1}^{2q+1} decay.
results.notes: The deterministic half of subspace iteration; cheap once the SVD API exists.

results.title: Nyström approximation error for PSD matrices
results.informal: For PSD A and any Ω: A ≽ A⟨Ω⟩ := AΩ(ΩᵀAΩ)†ΩᵀA ≽ 0, and A − A⟨Ω⟩ is the Schur complement; ‖A − A⟨Ω⟩‖ ≤ ‖(I−P)A^{1/2}‖² for P the projector onto range(A^{1/2}Ω). Foundation for Nyström, RPCholesky and Nyström preconditioning.

results.title: Sketched regression residual identities
results.informal: For Q orthonormal, Ψ a left sketch: the generalized Nyström core satisfies X̂ = QᵀA + (ΨᵀQ)†ΨᵀA⊥, with ‖Q⊥ᵀE‖ = ‖E‖ for E in range(Q⊥).

formalizations.note: ‖A − Â‖_F² = ‖(I−QQᵀ)A‖_F² + ‖G₁†G₂Q⊥ᵀE‖_F² with G₁ = ΨᵀQ, G₂ = ΨᵀQ⊥; plus sketchedCore/sketchedOutput/coreNoise, the core identity X̂ = QᵀA + coreNoise, ‖Q⊥ᵀE‖_F = ‖E‖_F and its spectral-norm version

results.title: Randomized SVD / range finder expected error
results.informal: E‖A − QQᵀA‖_F² ≤ (1 + k/(t−k−1))·‖A − ⟦A⟧_k‖_F² for a t-column Gaussian test matrix, t ≥ k+2.

formalizations.note: ported from the LRA project; takes the Gaussian moment identity hinv (E‖S₂Ω₂Ω₁†‖_F² = k/(t−k−1)‖S₂‖_F²) and the a.s. structural facts as hypotheses, as the source does. The hypothesis-free Gaussian version follows from gaussian-conditioning + pinv-frob-moment (next step).

results.notes: Conditional form ported. Follow-up: instantiate with Ω of law gaussianMatrix n t via the conditioning lemma and pinv_frobenius_moment to get an unconditional statement; generalise RangeFinder.lean to Fintype rows to recover the source's generality.

results.title: Generalized Nyström expected error
results.informal: E‖A − AΩ(ΨᵀAΩ)†ΨᵀA‖_F² ≤ (1 + q/(s−q−1))(1 + k/(t−k−1))·OPT².

formalizations.note: Chen–Persson thm:GN / Tropp–Webber Thm 5.1; the completion lemma and both forms of the theorem, Gaussian facts as expectation hypotheses (hinv, hcond or hG). Row index types Fin m, Fin n (the source allows any Fintype).

results.notes: Conditional form ported. The completion hypothesis hG is the conditioning lemma applied to Ψ with the blocks ΨᵀQ, ΨᵀQ⊥.

results.title: Truncated generalized Nyström expected error
results.informal: Constant-factor expected Frobenius error for the truncated one-pass estimator with s ≥ 4t, t ≥ 4k.

formalizations.note: conditional on hcore, hresid, hVN

results.title: Early-truncated RSVD
results.informal: Error of the early-truncated range finder via decoupled moments of w and χ and tail integrals of σ_min(Ω₁).

results.title: Early-truncated generalized Nyström
results.informal: Combines the early-truncated RSVD bound with the Gaussian completion step.

results.title: Randomized SVD deviation bounds
results.informal: High-probability versions of the RSVD bound with explicit failure probabilities.

results.title: Randomized Nyström expected error
results.informal: E‖A − A⟨Ω⟩‖_* ≤ (1 + k/(t−k−1))‖A − ⟦A⟧_k‖_* for Gaussian Ω.

results.title: Randomly pivoted Cholesky error bound
results.informal: After k ≥ (r/ε) + r log(1/(εη)) pivots, E tr(A − Â) ≤ (1+ε)·tr(A − ⟦A⟧_r) + η-type bound.

results.title: Block Krylov low-rank approximation
results.informal: Block Krylov with q = O(log(d/ε)/√ε) iterations gives (1+ε)σ_{k+1} spectral error; gap-independent.

results.title: Hutchinson estimator is unbiased
results.informal: If E zzᵀ = I then E[zᵀAz] = tr A. Holds for Gaussian, Rademacher and any isotropic z.

formalizations.note: pairwise independent, mean-zero, unit-variance coordinates on an abstract probability space

results.title: Variance of Gaussian and Rademacher trace estimators
results.informal: Var[gᵀAg] = 2‖A‖_F² (Gaussian, symmetric A); Var[εᵀAε] = 2(‖A‖_F² − Σ_i A_ii²) (Rademacher).

formalizations.note: general fourth-moment variance identity for any A (no symmetry), symmetric specialisation 2(‖A‖_F² − ΣA_ii²) + (m₄−1)ΣA_ii², and the m₄ = 3 (Gaussian) and m₄ = 1 (Rademacher) corollaries; proof uses iIndepFun.integral_fun_prod_comp rather than Isserlis

results.notes: Corollaries assume only the fourth moment m₄, not the Gaussian or Rademacher law; connecting them to gaussianMatrix / a Rademacher law is a small follow-up.

results.title: Tail bounds for trace estimators
results.informal: (ε,δ) sample complexity m = O(ε^{-2} log(1/δ)) for PSD A; Cortinovis–Kressner bounds for indefinite A via Hanson–Wright.

results.title: Stochastic diagonal estimation
results.informal: E[z ⊙ Az] = diag(A) for isotropic z with independent entries; variance per coordinate.

results.title: Hutch++ error bound
results.informal: O(1/ε) matrix-vector products suffice for (1±ε) relative trace error on PSD A.

results.title: Exchangeability-based estimators are unbiased
results.informal: Leave-one-out low-rank corrections preserve unbiasedness by exchangeability of the test vectors.

results.title: Spectral measure of a vector and moments uᵀf(A)u
results.informal: For Hermitian A and unit u, μ_u = Σ_i |⟨u, v_i⟩|² δ_{λ_i} satisfies uᵀf(A)u = ∫ f dμ_u; E_g[gᵀf(A)g] = tr f(A).

results.title: Krylov subspaces and their polynomial characterization
results.informal: K_q(A, b) = span{b, Ab, …, A^{q−1}b} = {p(A)b : deg p < q}; nesting, invariance, dimension ≤ q.

formalizations.note: polynomial characterisation, nesting, A-invariance into the next space, dimension bound

results.title: Lanczos three-term recurrence and tridiagonalization
results.informal: In exact arithmetic the Lanczos vectors are orthonormal, span K_q(A,b), and satisfy AQ_q = Q_qT_q + β_q q_{q+1}e_qᵀ with T_q Jacobi (tridiagonal).

results.title: Lanczos quadrature is Gauss quadrature on the spectral measure
results.informal: e₁ᵀf(T_q)e₁ = ∫ f dμ̂ where μ̂ is the q-point Gauss quadrature rule for μ_b; exact for polynomials of degree ≤ 2q−1.

results.title: Chebyshev polynomial extremal bounds
results.informal: min_{deg p ≤ q, p(0)=1} max_{[a,b]} |p| = 1/T_q((b+a)/(b−a)); T_q(1+γ) ≥ (1+√(2γ))^q/2 growth outside [−1,1]. Drives CG, Lanczos and block Krylov rates.

results.title: Random-start power and Lanczos bounds
results.informal: With a Gaussian start, E[λ_max − λ̂_max]/λ_max ≤ C log(n)/q for the power method and ≤ C log²(n)/q² for Lanczos.

results.title: Stochastic Lanczos quadrature error bound
results.informal: tr f(A) estimated to within ε with m = O(ε^{-2}log(1/δ)) samples and q = O(√κ log(1/ε)) Lanczos steps for analytic f.

results.title: Sketch-and-solve least squares
results.informal: If S is an ε-subspace embedding for [A b] then ‖Ax̃ − b‖ ≤ (1+ε)/(1−ε) min_x ‖Ax − b‖; with the AMM property, (1+ε) with k = O(d/ε).

results.title: Sketch-and-precondition conditioning bound
results.informal: If SA = QR and S is an ε-embedding for range(A) then κ(AR⁻¹) ≤ √((1+ε)/(1−ε)).

results.title: Randomized Kaczmarz converges linearly in expectation
results.informal: Choosing row i with probability ‖a_i‖²/‖A‖_F²: E‖x_k − x*‖² ≤ (1 − 1/κ_F²)^k ‖x_0 − x*‖², κ_F = ‖A‖_F‖A†‖. A one-page proof with large downstream reuse.

formalizations.note: Also sum_paths_le (explicit product-weighted sum over row sequences), expected_sqErr_step_le, expected_sqErr_step_eq. σ enters as the hypothesis ∀ v, σ²(v⬝v) ≤ (Av)⬝(Av), so any lower bound on σ_min works; no full-rank assumption.

results.notes: Proved in full over arbitrary finite index types with finite weighted sums instead of measure theory. Deviation from Strohmer–Vershynin: σ is any constant with σ²‖v‖² ≤ ‖Av‖², which recovers 1 − κ(A)⁻² under full column rank.

results.title: Sketch-and-project convergence
results.informal: E‖x_k − x*‖²_B ≤ (1 − λ_min(W))^k ‖x_0 − x*‖²_B with W = E[Z] the expected projector; recovers Kaczmarz, coordinate descent and block variants.

results.title: Nyström-preconditioned CG
results.informal: Condition number of the Nyström-preconditioned system is O(1) once rank exceeds the effective dimension.

results.title: Conditioning on an independent Gaussian block (tower property)
results.informal: If Y is standard Gaussian and independent of X, then E‖S·Y·T(X)‖_F² = ‖S‖_F²·E‖T(X)‖_F². Applied to the blocks V₁ᵀΩ, V₂ᵀΩ it turns the second-moment identity and the pseudoinverse moment into the expectation hypotheses of the RSVD and generalized Nyström theorems.

formalizations.note: no integrability hypothesis (proved via lintegral); companions integral_of_indepFun / lintegral_of_indepFun (Fubini for independent variables), rsvd_inverse_moment_factor, completion_inverse_moment_factor, integral_pinvR_frobSq_block

results.notes: Done. Mathlib gaps noted: no MeasurableSpace instance on Matrix; no lemma pulling IndepFun back along a map with a given law.

libraries.name: NLAlib (this repo)
libraries.scope: The library this atlas tracks. Layered modules Matrix → Concentration → Gaussian → Sketching → LowRank/Estimation/Krylov → Solvers; TroppMatrixConcentration re-exported under NLAlib.Concentration.Matrix.

libraries.name: Mathlib
libraries.scope: Upstream. Has stdGaussian / multivariateGaussian, HasSubgaussianMGF and the Chernoff-method sum bound, LinearMap.singularValues, the scoped Loewner order on matrices with CFC, Schur complements, matrix exponential, Gamma distribution. Lacks matrix SVD factorization, Eckart–Young, Weyl, Moore–Penrose, chi-square tails, any random matrix theory.

libraries.name: TroppMatrixConcentration (this repo)
libraries.scope: Tropp 2015 Ch. 3–8, 49 theorems, sorry-free, all Proved on Prove2me.

libraries.name: Gaussian Random Matrices I–III (Prove2me)
libraries.scope: Three-mission series in namespace GaussianMatrix on the shared definition bundle GaussianMatrix_basic. Mission I complete; II and III partly open.

libraries.name: LRA (Chen–Persson formalization)
libraries.scope: Local project (~/Documents/Papers/LRA-paper/formal). 253 theorems; RSVD, GN, tGN, etRSVD, etGN proved conditional on explicit Gaussian Props in LRA/Standard/Gaussian.lean.

libraries.name: HighDimProb
libraries.scope: External. Hoeffding, Bernstein, Hanson–Wright with explicit constant 1/(256e²) stated on Mathlib's HasSubgaussianMGF and iIndepFun, covering numbers, Dudley chaining, a Matrix Bernstein route, sample covariance. Pinned to Lean v4.29.1 and reported failing to build on v4.31–v4.33, so it cannot be a lake dependency of the Prove2me-pinned projects; treat as a proof quarry to port from.

libraries.name: AI4SLT (empirical processes in Lean)
libraries.scope: External, ~30k lines. Gaussian Lipschitz concentration via Gaussian log-Sobolev; Dudley entropy integral.

libraries.name: arlib
libraries.scope: External, 305 modules. Finite probability, concentration, Markov chains, coresets. No linear algebra.

libraries.name: OpenProblemsInNLA TR-01 companion (rerandomized SRHT)
libraries.scope: External. Prescribed-width subspace embedding theorem for a rerandomized SRHT, with kernel replay.

libraries.name: SparseStack OSE formalization
libraries.scope: External. Fixed-matrix theorem that fully independent SparseStack is an optimal oblivious subspace embedding. Repository URL not given in the abstract.

libraries.name: Finite-precision Krylov examples
libraries.scope: External. Exact rounding examples for CG/Lanczos; specific cases, not general theory.
